integrity: All finite cases are exhausted using exact characteristic-two polynomial arithmetic and Gröbner bases on three affine charts; two standalone implementations and reference outputs included. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic classification over F2 only. The coefficient-form count is distinct from geometric isomorphism over an algebraic closure. The earlier 78-class genus-three quartic census and the 24 seven-point Gauss-bijective cases are not claimed as new. Publication-priority risk remains for unindexed tangent-incidence computations using previously published normal forms.
title: Twenty projective classes of tangent-filling smooth plane quartics over \(\mathbf F_2\)
